title: Smith normal form for a submodule of a finite free PID module
statement: Let $R$ be a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], let $E$ be a finite free $R$-module, and let $N\subseteq E$ be a submodule. For any basis of $E$, there are bases of $E$ and $N$ such that the inclusion $N\hookrightarrow E$ is diagonal: each basis vector of $N$ maps to a scalar multiple of a distinct basis vector of $E$, and the number of basis vectors of $N$ is at most the rank of $E$.
